name: Burndown
subtitle: Fast words. Last player wins.
shortDescription: Race the alphabet on separate phones or around one shared table.
description: Burndown is a rapid word party game for two to eight players. Pick a category, beat the clock, burn letters, challenge answers, and survive with the last lives on the board. Play on separate phones or pass one device with a full privacy handoff curtain, shared voting, wake lock, spectators, and TV projection.
reviewNotes: Choose Share this device to review without an account or backend. Shared-table mode intentionally keeps the screen awake only while a match is active.
releaseNotes: Initial mobile release with separate-phone and shared-table modes, 2–8 players, challenges, custom categories, host recovery, spectators, TV projection, and native sharing.
